name: Fellow.ai
description: Access your meeting knowledge instantly. Fellow connects Claude to your meeting ecosystem, letting you search transcripts, pull key insights from summaries, and track action items with natural-language queries.

_published_faq.name: How do I add Fellow.ai to Claude, ChatGPT, or Cursor?

acceptedAnswer.text: Add Fellow.ai to Claude, ChatGPT, or Cursor by connecting its remote MCP URL in each client's MCP settings. In Claude, add a custom connector. In ChatGPT, add an MCP app. In Cursor, add an MCP server under Settings. The MCP URL is https://fellow.app/mcp. This server requires OAuth, so complete the login prompt after you connect.

_published_faq.name: What tools does the Fellow.ai MCP server provide?

acceptedAnswer.text: Fellow.ai provides these MCP tools: get_action_items, get_meeting_participants, get_meeting_summary, get_meeting_transcript, and search_meetings.

_published_faq.name: What are the best alternatives to Fellow.ai?

acceptedAnswer.text: As of October 17, 2026, alternatives to Fellow.ai in communication on the Manufact MCP catalog include AgentLine: Phone Numbers for AI Agents, JooVoice, OpenMail, Granola, and Fleet Connected Apps.
Fellow.ai requires authentication. Connect it in Claude, ChatGPT, or Cursor and complete the OAuth login prompt.
Fellow.ai is developed by Fellow.ai. It is listed as partner on the Claude connector directory.
